fields.label: About
fields.options: Unofficial WhatsApp integration. Tarceel is an unofficial, QR-linked WhatsApp integration — not the official WhatsApp Business Platform, and not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta. It links a real WhatsApp number via QR code, so that number can be rate-limited or banned if used for unsolicited or bulk messaging. This app sends only per-document, individually composed messages and never bypasses Tarceel's rate-limiting / anti-ban safety.
